rules.@typescript-eslint/no-deprecated: return a message, or fall through to undefined

forbid.message: Use <Button> from @/components/ui/button, or add a variant to buttonVariants if none fits.
Use <Input> from @/components/ui/input, or the matching Base UI primitive wrapper in @/components/ui.
